bibl.title: Inventario bilingue dei beni di un monastero (PL III/1005)
bibl.seg: Agostino Soldati, Inventario bilingue dei beni di un monastero (PL III/1005).
bibl.note: List of assets owned by a monastery presumably located near the port of Antinoupolis, 6th century. The list in Greek is followed by a more concise translation into Coptic language. Both lists contain interesting lexical occurrences, some of which are not otherwise known.
